verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one user's report that Shortwave imported their existing Gmail aliases, which suggests you can keep sending from alias addresses you already set up elsewhere. There is no evidence that Shortwave can create or manage masked or disposable addresses itself. Missing for 10: native masked/disposable address generation, alias creation and management inside Shortwave, first-party documentation of alias support, and evidence that the real address stays hidden from sign-ups and senders.
